title: Understanding Recall
text: Recall is the ratio of true positive predictions to the total actual positives. It helps us understand how well the model identifies positive instances.

title: Identifying True Positives
text: Look at the test results and identify which predictions are true positives. A true positive is when the true label is $$1$$ and the prediction is also $$1$$.

title: Counting Actual Positives
text: Count how many instances have a true label of $$1$$. This will give you the total number of actual positives.

title: Calculating Recall
text: Using the formula for recall, calculate the recall value. Recall is true positives divided by actual positives.
